verdicts.hypothesis: Tightening began only after the October stock peak
verdicts.basis: Five of six 2007 benchmark-rate hikes and seven of ten effective RRR hikes preceded Oct16. Oct13 RRR announcement preceded peak; its Oct25 effective date followed peak.
Nov26 and Dec25 RRR rises, Dec21 rate hike, Dec5 tight-stance announcement and H1 2008 RRR rises followed Oct16 peak. Equity-specific stamp duty eased Apr24 while RRR tightened Apr25.

verdicts.hypothesis: Market trading activity weakened before peak
verdicts.basis: Daily-average turnover fell May-to-July, recovered August, eased September; October straddles peak and cannot locate intramonth change.

verdicts.verdict: verified for Oct-Nov; not monotonic afterward
verdicts.basis: Nov average below Oct; Dec and Jan recovered. January market fell 16.69% despite higher turnover.

verdicts.hypothesis: Retail net purchases turned negative before peak
verdicts.basis: No original monthly natural-person buy/sell split was retained. Gross openings, effective/holding/active-account stocks, survey preference and all-investor turnover do not identify signed retail flow.

verdicts.hypothesis: Falling new accounts identifies retail exit
verdicts.basis: Daily scattered observations are new-account flows, not sales or account closures; prepeak Oct15 openings were reported up. No continuous series or predeclared change-point test is supported.

verdicts.hypothesis: Share supply pressure rose around peak
verdicts.verdict: fundraising/float stocks verified; actual unlock sales/causal impact unconfirmed
verdicts.basis: Official monthly IPO/follow-on proceeds and float-share totals are distinct. Float changes can include issuance/conversion/coverage changes; they do not measure insiders' realized selling.

verdicts.hypothesis: Nationwide account totals prove the entire population bought
verdicts.basis: Accounts are not unique persons; dormant accounts and cross-exchange double counts matter. Oct8 segregation of20.23m dormant accounts is a structural break, not mass current-investor liquidation.

limitations: Descriptive timing is not a controlled causal event study. Anticipation, inflation, earnings, issuance and global shocks confound effects.
Monthly observations mix days before/after Oct16; month-end reports become public later. Observation time and release time are both retained.

All-investor national stock turnover is not a direct Shanghai-only or retail-flow measure. CSRC reported trading-day counts equal actual SSE close counts in all18 months; Shenzhen daily calendar was not independently retrieved, so exact daily holiday identity is not claimed.

Some original XLS published daily averages differ from monthly total divided by trading days by more than standard 2-decimal rounding (max0.018333 CNY100million/day). Both values and exact differences are retained; report/source comparisons use the published values consistently, without silent correction.
Dated contemporary press is used only where CSDC original pages were not recovered; daily samples do not form a complete time series.
Annual retail net-flow totals, even if positive or negative, cannot establish the month of a reversal; none are used to time it.

CSRC_AR2007 downloaded PDF is a current navigation-page PDF, not the requested report, and is invalid/excluded. CSDC_AR2006 and PBOC_DEC20_QA direct retrieval failed; their bytes/search snippets are not primary evidence.
All rate announcements are date-level; no event-return causality or intraday tradability is inferred. First-session alignment is a calendar label only, not a same-day response estimate.
